extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians in rings and algebras, especially those working on composition algebras and Cayley–Dickson constructions
extracted.subtask_description: A short research article investigating generalizations of the notions of level and sublevel from composition algebras to algebras obtained via the Cayley–Dickson process, and constructions of division algebras with prescribed level/sublevel. Note: this arXiv submission/version has been withdrawn by the author due to errors.
